lead: This is what the public will see. Check it, tick the box and publish.
noPhotos: No photos will be shown yet.
pendingDraft: Your saved changes are included: publishing uses the text and facts you saved last.

blockers.title_missing: There is no Bulgarian title. Add one in the listing text.
blockers.description_missing: There is no Bulgarian description. Add one in the listing text.
blockers.price_undecided: There is no price. Enter the price, or choose “price on request”.
blockers.location_missing: The location is missing. Add the settlement in the listing facts.
blockers.not_available: The property is sold, let or off the market, so it cannot be advertised. If it is on offer again, record that in Detailed review first.
blockers.rent_period_unconfirmed: The rent has no period. Choose “per month” in the Rent period field.

warnings.no_photos: There are no photos to show. The listing will go online without photos.
warnings.photos_not_ready: Some photos are still being prepared. They will appear once they are ready and you approve them.
warnings.short_description: The description is very short. Buyers usually need more detail.
warnings.bedrooms_unknown: The number of bedrooms is not known.
warnings.inland_framed_as_coast: The text describes an inland town as being by the sea or a beach. Please check the wording.
warnings.title_site_suffix: The title ends with the old site's name. It is shown without it below.

attestation: I checked this listing. The facts are right, the owner asked us to advertise it on these terms, we may use these photos, and it is available.
attestationRequired: Tick the box to confirm that you checked the listing.
fixFirst: Fix the items marked “Must be fixed” first, then come back here.
detailedReviewHint: Every recorded check and decision, one by one.
cannotPublish: Your role cannot publish listings. Ask a colleague who can.
basis: Published by {names} on their own check.
unpublishLead: Unpublishing removes the listing from the website at once. You can publish it again later.
unpublishConfirm: Take this listing off the website
unpublished: Unpublished. {reference} is no longer on the website.

reasons.not_attested: Tick the box to confirm that you checked the listing.
reasons.another_person_required: A colleague must publish this listing: you wrote it, and this agency asks for a second person.
reasons.seller_documents_required: This agency needs the owner's signed documents before publishing. Upload and check them in Detailed review.
reasons.professional_review_required: The text makes legal or tax statements. Have them checked in Detailed review first.
reasons.photos_required: Some photos are not ready yet, and this agency publishes only with every photo ready.
reasons.shared_facts_published: Another listing of the same property is online. Unpublish it first, then publish both again.
reasons.no_permission: Your role cannot do one of the steps needed to publish this listing.
reasons.changed_since_opened: The listing changed while you were checking it. Open it again and check the new version.
reasons.facts_incomplete: Some facts are still missing. Complete them in the listing.
reasons.other: The listing could not be published. Open Detailed review to see what is missing.

ready.lead: These listings pass every check and are still on the market. Select the ones you checked, tick the box and publish them.
ready.none: No listings are ready to publish. A listing appears here when nothing needs fixing and it is not on the website yet.
ready.selectAll: Select all listings on this page
ready.attestation: I checked each selected listing. The facts are right, the owners asked us to advertise them on these terms, we may use these photos, and they are available.
ready.languageLead: These listings are online in Bulgarian and their {language} text passed every check. Read each text, tick the box and publish them in {language}.
ready.languageNone: No {language} texts are ready. A text appears here when the listing is online in Bulgarian and the text passes every check.
ready.languageAttest: I read these texts in {language} and each says the same as the Bulgarian.

today.title: Check and publish {reference}
today.readyNext: open the list, check and publish

rentHint: The old site recorded this rent without a period. Publishing records it as the monthly rent.
cleanTitle: Remove the old site's ending from the title
cleanTitles: Remove the old site's endings from the titles shown

languages.heading: Languages
languages.lead: Each language goes online only when you tick it. Tick only the languages you can read.
languages.attest: I read the {language} text and it says the same as the Bulgarian.
languages.legacy: The old site recorded this text as approved and published by the agency. Your tick confirms it.
languages.cannot: Your role cannot approve translations in this language.
languages.none: There are no translations of this listing yet.

checks.empty: The translation is empty. Add the text in Edit a translation in detail.
checks.same_as_source: The text is the same as the Bulgarian, so it is not translated yet.
checks.numbers_differ: These numbers are not in the listing: {code}. Correct them in Edit a translation in detail.
checks.inland_framed_as_coast: The text describes an inland town as being by the sea or a beach. Correct the wording.
checks.length_implausible: The text is much shorter or longer than the Bulgarian, so part may be missing.
checks.length_unusual: The text is noticeably shorter or longer than the Bulgarian.
checks.place_name_missing: The place named in the Bulgarian text does not appear.

reasons.source_not_published: Publish the listing first; its languages follow it.
reasons.checks_failed: The check found a problem in this text.
reasons.no_permission: Your role cannot approve translations in this language.
reasons.no_draft: There is no translation in this language.
reasons.other: This language could not be published. Open Detailed review.
